labels: Injected timing departures only; stable, jitter, seasonal, missing and observer-reset controls are benign. No attack or root-cause labels.
baseline: EWMA/CUSUM mean and sample standard deviation are frozen from first 32 preceding frames, sigma floor 0.5 ms. Reset starts fresh warmup for all methods.
events: Contiguous flagged measured frames form events. Missing frames are unknown and break a run. One-to-one earliest overlap matches; extra events are false/duplicate incidents. Recovery delay uses last flag within the fault plus any immediately contiguous flags after it; no flag means no recovery estimate.
success: Publish all outcomes and uncertainty. Superiority requires independent corroboration; default engine policy remains unchanged in this milestone.
